title: Wood & Magic Icon
description: A simple resource pack for Magic & Magic
body:
**Minecraft Resource Pack** used with [**Wood & Magic [Fabric]**](https://modrinth.com/modpack/wood-magic-fabric)

Check [**This Image**](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/wood-magic-icon/gallery) to see how it looks.

This resource pack is for **1.20.1** version!
